FAQs on Priority Lending

(Updated as on September 11, 2026)

Sr. No.FAQ
A. Classification of loans
1.Query 1: Can gadget loans be classified as priority lending?

Clarification: Yes. Banks shall classify them as provided in the Master Directions on Priority Lending, 2025.
B. Computation
2.Query 2: How is the adjusted credit computed?

Clarification: The net certificate outstanding is added to credit, as mentioned in para 6 of the Master Directions on Priority Lending, 2025.
3.Query 3: Where can the scheme be read?

Clarification: The scheme is described on the association's website.
